project_name: DarkShield AI - Scalable Threat Intelligence Module
ai_instructions: Acting as an expert Full-Stack Software Engineer, read this complete architecture layout and recreate the system matching these exact technical specifications, features, and UI interactions.

core_behavior.data_flow: React polls GET /api/threats every 5000ms. UI has an Add Org button. Hitting SCAN triggers POST /api/scan with URL. Node backend pushes a '[AUTO-TRACKING INITIATED]' event. Node spins up Headless Playwright script mapping .onion to proxy. Playwright prints '## Launching...' which Node catches via stdout. Node injects those live intermediate chat-logs into memory and MongoDB as MEDIUM risk traces. Upon completion, Playwright saves JSON, Node reads JSON, formats completely, puts HIGH RISK log into DB.
core_behavior.automation: server.js has a setInterval running every 45000ms scanning an array of strings (e.g., pastebin.com) continuously mapping background scans without user input.

react_dashboard.theme: Dark mode 'Cybersecurity Command Center', glowing borders, glassmorphism UI.
components: LiveFeed: Center grid monitoring live traces and JSON final outputs. Pulsing indicators.
CompanyMonitor (Affected Companies): Right sidebar. Reads complete array of threats dynamically aggregating the top 10 companies detected, bypassing fixed lists.
OrganizationMonitoring: Add Modal that allows inputting Custom Names if not in default list. View details triggers a focused feed.

express_bridge.logic: Provides seamless JSON API. Uses Mongoose to connect to 'darkshield_intelligence' database.

scraper_engine.logic: Extracts unique emails using Regex against document.body.innerText. Maps <a> tags finding sensitive raw databases. Executes fast and closes. Returns payload matching TorCrawl structures.

ThreatSchema.companyName: String (With explicit strict fallback to null if parsing fails. Extracts pure domain name without www.)

entities.companies: Array of Strings (Always avoids [null], instead keeps [])
